---
title: Paid apps
---

# Paid apps

An app or a template can be free, or bought once:

```toml
[pricing]
model = "one_time"
```

## Before you can release it

1. **Set up payouts.** In the developer portal, **Set up payouts** takes you to Stripe to set up your organisation's account.
   Whether it can be paid is Stripe's to say: the portal shows it once Stripe has.
2. **Set its price**, in the portal, from A$1 to A$10,000. A price change needs no review.

A paid version can't be released until both are in place.

## What a buyer sees

The Marketplace shows your price. An owner or admin buys it once, through Stripe, and can then install it, or choose your template in
Compose. Until it is bought, it can't be installed.

## What you are paid

eBillAddress keeps 20% of each sale. You receive the rest through Stripe, less Stripe's fees. Prices are in Australian dollars.

## Refunds

A buyer may ask eBillAddress for a refund within 14 days of paying. When eBillAddress refunds a purchase, the buyer gets the whole
payment back, your share of it is taken back, and the app's access for that organisation ends.

## Going from free to paid

An organisation that installed your app while it was free keeps the version it has, which goes on working. It moves to a paid version
only once it buys the app.
